podcast.body: Santana's first hit single, which made it to number four on the Billboard Pop Chart in January 1971. The song was written by Peter Green of the original Fleetwood Mac. "Black Magic Woman was Santana's first hit single. It made it to number four on the Billboard Pop Chart in January 1971."

Ep. 25 - The Hispanic Influence on 70s Popular Music

podcast.body: Santana, a Latin rock band, turned Peter Green's original 1968 Fleetwood Mac song "Black Magic Woman" into a top 5 US hit. This highlights the early Fleetwood Mac's influence on their contemporaries and the enduring appeal of their songs. "Black Magic Woman, of course, later became a top 5 US hit for Latin rock band Santana."
